description: Election Commission - Notice under Section 66A (1)(a) Appointed Mr. N.M. Neel Navarathna as a Member of Karuwalagaswewa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Karuwalagaswewa Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for declaring a new member elected to fill a seat vacated by resignation, which falls under election-related matters and procedures.
